title.en: Architecting High-Availability Telegram Incident Alert Bots with Serverless Python
title.id: Arsitektur Bot Alert Insiden Telegram High-Availability dengan Serverless Python
title.zh: 基于Serverless Python构建高可用Telegram运维报警机器人
title.ja: サーバーレスPythonによる高可用性Telegramインシデント通知ボットの設計
title.ko: 서버리스 Python 기반 고가용성 Telegram 인시던트 알림 봇 아키텍처

desc.en: Replacing expensive PagerDuty subscriptions with asynchronous serverless incident dispatching and interactive escalation buttons.
desc.id: Menggantikan langganan PagerDuty mahal dengan bot notifikasi insiden serverless dan tombol eskalasi interaktif.
desc.zh: 用基于Serverless的异步故障报警与交互式升级按钮方案，替代昂贵的企业级PagerDuty订阅。
desc.ja: 高額なPagerDuty契約を見直し、インタラクティブボタンを備えたサーバーレス障害通知基盤へ移行。
desc.ko: 고가의 온콜 유료 도구를 대체하여 인터랙티브 에스컬레이션 버튼을 갖춘 서버리스 인시던트 알림 봇 구축.

body.en:
Replacing expensive PagerDuty subscriptions with asynchronous serverless incident dispatching and interactive escalation buttons.

Why Traditional Enterprise Alerting Is Overpriced for Growing Teams

Enterprise alerting tools charge per-seat pricing that penalizes small Indonesian engineering teams. Developers end up sharing single credentials or muting email alerts, delaying response times during weekend production database outages.

100%incident alert delivery within 2s
$340/mosaved on PagerDuty licenses
4on-call escalation levels

Telegram Webhook Architecture with AWS Lambda & Cloudflare

We deployed lightweight serverless webhooks on AWS Lambda fronted by Cloudflare. Incoming Prometheus Alertmanager webhooks format rich markdown incident summaries with one-tap acknowledgment buttons delivered directly to team phones.

Stateful Escalation Loops in DynamoDB

If an on-duty engineer fails to press the Acknowledge button within 5 minutes, an automated step-function triggers phone calls and cascades alerts up the engineering management ladder until resolved.

Interactive Escalation Button Dispatcher
import httpx

async def send_ops_alert(bot_token: str, chat_id: str, incident: dict):
    url = f"https://api.telegram.org/bot{bot_token}/sendMessage"
    payload = {
        "chat_id": chat_id,
        "text": f"🔥 *CRITICAL INCIDENT* \nService: `{incident['service']}`\nError: {incident['error']}",
        "parse_mode": "Markdown",
        "reply_markup": {
            "inline_keyboard": [[
                {"text": "✅ Acknowledge", "callback_data": f"ack_{incident['id']}"},
                {"text": "🚨 Escalate Lead", "callback_data": f"esc_{incident['id']}"}
            ]]
        }
    }
    async with httpx.AsyncClient() as client:
        await client.post(url, json=payload, timeout=5.0)

Audit Logging and Post-Mortem Compilation

Every button tap and acknowledgment timestamp is saved to an audit ledger, automatically compiling preliminary post-mortem documentation for Monday morning engineering retrospectives.
